svg.aria-label: Microsoft Azure Reference Architecture: 3-Act Data to Intelligence to Experience
svg.text: The Modern Azure Journey: Where Data Meets AI (Data → Intelligence → Experience)
Reference Architecture: Extending Azure Databricks Unity Catalog Investments with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Fabric IQ & Microsoft Foundry
Meet Customers Where Their Data Already Lives
— Bidirectional Zero-Copy Interoperability Without Forced Migration
• Existing Bronze → Silver → Gold Medallion tables
• Unity Catalog Open APIs enabled on metastore
Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (Delta / Parquet)
Zero Data Movement • Single Copy in Storage
Trusted OneLake Data → Semantic Business Context
Turn Trusted Business Data into Intelligence
— Fabric IQ Semantic Layer, Fabric Data Agents & Microsoft Foundry
• Direct Lake Semantic Models & DAX Measures
• Verified Few-Shot SQL / DAX / KQL Queries
Published Knowledge Tool • Entra ID OBO Security
Publish & Expose Intelligence Where Users Work
Put AI Where Users Actually Work
— The Architecture Can Be Sophisticated; The User Experience Shouldn't Have To Be
Unified Security & Governance Plane: Microsoft Entra ID • Unity Catalog Privileges • OneLake Security Roles • Fabric Workspace Identity • End-to-End OBO Identity Pass-Through
